states.idle: No lift; low glow; slow 6–8 s spectral border runner; sparse light nodes.
states.hover: Lift about 2 px; brighter glow; spectral runner accelerates to about 2.8–3.6 s.
states.pressed: Return to 0/+1 px; brief 0.99 compression; bright 120–220 ms spectral pulse; action fires immediately.
states.focus: Visible cyan/violet focus ring independent of pointer hover.
states.disabled: No lift; no runner; reduced contrast; not actionable.
